_comment: Lending / financing product-type profile. A lending product compiles affordability, credit-risk and collections requirements a payments product never sees.

medium._pa1_comment: rc.38 (flow-plan Phase 4.6) — pull objections LEFT. Both roles were compiled into the plan and first engaged at PA2, which is the most expensive place in the route to discover an objection: the analysis is finished, the build is done, and a credit-risk or data-protection challenge at that point re-opens work that PA1 could have shaped. `data-protection` binds at PA1 only when the change actually carries personal data, because the role itself is added by the regulated-bank `personal_data` conditional and pa1Roles() intersects with what the plan compiled — naming it here costs nothing on a change that does not touch personal data.
